title: What a pizza-ordering hackathon reveals about connecting AI agents to the Web
partialText: Participants in a hackathon hosted by popular AI newsletter AlphaSignal used the Brave Search API to build an autonomous agent, and get that agent to reliably act in the real world.

title: Brave for Desktop Outperforms Other Browsers in Speed and Performance
partialText: New tests on macOS show Brave for desktop outperforms Chrome, Edge, and Firefox in page-load speed, CPU, memory, energy, and network use. This post includes the full methodology and results.

title: Brave Accounts: your password never leaves your device, ever.
partialText: Brave Accounts is a brand-new way to sign into Brave services like Email Aliases. Built on the OPAQUE cryptographic protocol, your password is never sent to our servers—not encrypted, not hashed—so it never leaves your device.

title: Brave launches Email Aliases to keep your personal email address private from websites
partialText: Starting with desktop version 1.94, Brave is offering Email Aliases to let you sign up for online services without revealing your personal email address. Aliases forward to your primary inbox, helping reduce spam and break cross-site tracking.

title: Brave improves protections against GPU fingerprinting
partialText: Starting in version 1.93, Brave is rolling out new protections against GPU and graphics-driver fingerprinting, de-identifying WebGL vendor and renderer strings and adding noise to the list of supported extensions.

title: BAT Roadmap 4.0
partialText: BAT Roadmap 4.0 evolves the Basic Attention Token, Brave Rewards, and Brave Creators for the transactional attention economy, introducing agentic payments, a unified Brave Wallet, the BravePay stablecoin protocol, a Brave Rewards Card, and a Creator Contribution Protocol.

title: Brave Place Search API: The Google Maps Alternative That Costs 6–7x Less
partialText: Brave's improved Place Search API matches Google Maps on quality in real-world tests, at 6–7x lower cost—$5 per 1,000 requests on an independent index built for maps, apps, and AI agents.

title: Brave’s latest browser release offers Containers for better and easier workflow
partialText: Today's Brave browser release (v1.92) adds built-in Containers on desktop, letting you isolate tabs so cookies and storage aren't shared—making it easy to manage multiple accounts or separate work and personal browsing, with no extension required.

title: Claude Cowork on Amazon Bedrock with Brave Search: bringing real-time Web intelligence for your organization
partialText: In this post we dive deep into how to configure the Cowork desktop application with AWS Bedrock, and how to add Brave Search as the local MCP server for interactive, user-driven workflows.

title: Brave Rewards Partner Program 2026 update: more ways to use BAT in gaming, shopping, and beyond
partialText: This month's Brave Rewards Partner Program update introduces six new partners and shares milestones from existing ones, expanding how users can earn, spend, and use BAT across gaming, shopping, research, and more.
